fusions.name: Hopping Barbs
fusions.desc: Pricks every enemy within 2 tiles for 3 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Parasite Pick
fusions.desc: A weapon strike on a target carrying one of your afflictions that deals 8 damage and uses that affliction up. It makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Spring Away
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, and your dodge chance rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Prickling Welts
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
